title: Funeral films of Kid Rena and Black Benny; Rene's Catholic funeral and wake
summary: Rene says newsreel cameras filmed his brother's and Black Benny's funerals. His brother's had no music because of his wife and priest, then burial in the society tomb at St. Louis No. 2; a flower-filled wake.

blocks.x: Okay, we got everybody's name down. See, we're going to talk some more about the funerals that they, that they had like ones where they made pictures. You said they made pictures? They made moving pictures of your brother?
Moving pictures of my brother and also of Black Benny. Uh huh. Yeah.
Did they take the sound trucks with them and microphones and everything? No, no, no.
